slug: 2024-11-13 Burkina Faso - digitalisation of birth declarations and civil status (VENEEM)

facts.fact: The document describes VENEEM as a digital civil-registration platform for the systematic declaration of civil-status events, capturing births and other events at their point of occurrence, in health facilities and elsewhere, per the Director of the unique identifier and securing of civil-status documents; deaths are not named; the date is the document's.

The document states that VENEEM captures events at their point of occurrence, runs on computers and smartphones, and supports notifications and level-by-level validation under the Code des personnes et de la famille; it does not say where the record is held; the date is the document's.

The platform is presented by Commissaire principal Ousmane Diallo Nacanabo, Director of the unique identifier and securing of civil-status documents, a state official; the document names no ministry; the date is the document's.
